reviewer.role: Independent AI scientific visual reviewer; not author or audience scorer
reviewer.model: inherited native agent (API未提供精確版本)

scope: Fresh review of new visual plan, renderer implementation and sampled PNG previews against unchanged scientific claims; not a reuse of the former visual pass.

original_fact_basis.method: Previously independently visited primary sources retained for unchanged claims. No fresh full-source research or audience rescoring in this incremental visual review.
original_fact_basis.excluded: NASA Cosmicopia timeout remains excluded even though its historical card remains in source-cards.json.

public_content_check.narration_and_timeline: Original files bound by per-topic manifest; unchanged bytes verified.

limitations: Pre-encode Pillow PNG previews and renderer code; no new MP4 exists within this review scope.
Contact sheet covers all ten cue midpoints; selected original-size images and motion pairs inspected. This is not continuous full-video/audio viewing.
No human first-watch, mobile legibility, professional scientist certification, audience score, aesthetic guarantee or market acceptance.
Qualitative scientific schematics: lengths, colors, particle spacing, wave timing and apparatus are simplified. These are not physical simulations or quantitative measurements.
Approval binds these exact renderer and inputs hashes. Changed renderer, assets, timeline or public claims need renewed review; actual encoded MP4 sampling remains required.

air_particles x=fixed_x+8*sin(5t-.7j), fixed y: each particle remains within ±8px of its own equilibrium; no transport across panel or vacuum. Frames380/386 show changing local offsets with the disturbance marker advancing right. Phase progression also advances right.
checks.caveat: Traveling outline is a qualitative emphasis marker, not a computed pressure-front or calibrated phase-speed trace; regular particle rows illustrate coherent acoustic displacement, not literal gas molecular trajectories.
